Website Design & Development

NEXORA Pixel Designer provides professional website design and development services tailored to the unique needs of every business and organization.

Our experienced creative and development team is dedicated to delivering innovative, responsive, user-friendly and cost-effective digital solutions. By combining modern technologies with creative design techniques, we build websites that meet high standards of functionality, performance, accessibility and visual appeal.

From initial planning and UI/UX design to front-end development, testing and final delivery, we manage every stage with attention to detail and a commitment to excellence.

Our services focus on creating responsive, SEO-friendly and performance-optimized websites that help businesses establish a strong online presence and achieve their digital goals.

We are committed to delivering high-quality projects on time, within budget and to our clients' satisfaction.

Company

About NEXORA

NEXORA is a creative digital design and technology company specializing in Graphic Design, UI/UX Design, Branding, Web Development, 3D Visualization, and Multimedia Production. We deliver innovative, user-focused, and high-quality digital solutions that help businesses build strong identities and establish a powerful online presence.

Our services include professional logo design, brand identity development, social media graphics, marketing banners, business materials, UI/UX design, responsive website design, and custom web development using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. We also provide 3D modeling, architectural visualization, video editing, and creative multimedia solutions to meet diverse business and client requirements.

Our experienced creative team combines technical expertise with artistic vision to develop practical, attractive, and effective solutions for projects of all sizes. We focus on understanding each client's objectives, brand values, and target audience to create designs that communicate clearly and deliver meaningful results.

NEXORA is committed to using modern design software, advanced digital technologies, and industry-standard development practices. Through creativity, innovation, and attention to detail, we ensure that every project reflects quality, functionality, consistency, and professionalism.

From brand development and digital marketing materials to complete website solutions and 3D visual presentations, we provide integrated creative services tailored to the evolving needs of businesses in both local and international markets.

At NEXORA, our mission is to transform ideas into impactful digital experiences through creativity, technology, and excellence.

Our Team

NEXORA is powered by a team of experienced creative professionals, designers, and technology specialists with expertise in Graphic Design, UI/UX Design, Branding, Web Development, and 3D Visualization. Our team combines creative vision, technical knowledge, and modern industry practices to deliver innovative and effective solutions for every project.

With experience working alongside leading businesses, creative agencies, and design professionals, our team brings valuable industry knowledge and a diverse range of creative skills. We focus on understanding client requirements, exploring innovative ideas, and transforming concepts into practical, visually compelling, and user-friendly solutions.

Our collaborative approach, attention to detail, and commitment to continuous improvement enable us to deliver high-quality results for projects of all sizes. By combining creativity with technology, we strive to exceed expectations and build lasting relationships with our clients.

At NEXORA, our people are our strength, creativity is our passion, and excellence is our commitment.

Founder & CEO

Mardiat Islam Safin

Creative Design Engineer

Mardiat Islam Safin is the Founder & CEO of NEXORA, bringing a multidisciplinary background in Graphic Design, Digital Creativity, UI/UX Design, and Web Development. He pursued a four-year Bachelor of Social Science (BSS) program at Bangladesh Open University and completed professional training in Graphic Design at Creative IT Institute, Dhaka. He also has an academic interest in Computer Science and technical education.

With a strong passion for innovation, creative problem-solving, and emerging digital technologies, he specializes in developing impactful design strategies and delivering high-quality digital solutions. His core areas of expertise include Graphic Design, UI/UX Design, Brand Identity Development, Digital Design, Web Design, and Front-End Development.

As Founder & CEO of NEXORA, he leads the company's strategic direction, creative vision, business development, and innovation initiatives. He remains actively involved in transforming ideas into practical, visually compelling, and technology-driven solutions that deliver value to clients and businesses.

His leadership is built on creativity, technical excellence, continuous learning, strategic thinking, and a commitment to creating meaningful digital experiences that empower businesses and support sustainable growth.

Leadership Philosophy: “Turning creative ideas into meaningful digital solutions through innovation, dedication, and excellence.”

WE ARE HIRING!

Draftsman / Graphic Design Specialist

NEXORA Pixel Ltd. is looking for a skilled, creative, and detail-oriented professional to join our growing creative and technical team.

If you are passionate about design, technical drawing, and digital creativity, this is an excellent opportunity to work on real-world projects and develop your professional career.

Position Details

  • Position: Draftsman / Graphic Design Specialist
  • Job Type: Full-Time
  • Work Location: Office-Based

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare professional graphic and digital design materials.
  • Create UI/UX layouts and website design mockups.
  • Develop technical drawings and design documentation.
  • Create social media posts, banners, brochures, and marketing materials.
  • Modify designs based on client and team feedback.
  • Maintain design quality, accuracy, and project requirements.
  • Collaborate with the creative and development teams.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator.
  • Knowledge of UI/UX design tools and principles.
  • Understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is an advantage.
  • Good knowledge of graphic design and visual communication.
  • Creativity, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
  • Relevant diploma, training, or professional experience preferred.

Why Join NEXORA Pixel Ltd.?

  • Work with a professional creative and technical team.
  • Opportunity to develop your creative and technical skills.
  • Experience working on real-world digital projects.
  • Career growth and professional development opportunities.
  • Friendly and collaborative work environment.
